evals.name: pinned-narrative
evals.prompt: Build me a single-page site for a small-batch coffee roaster called Ridgeline. I want it to feel cinematic — as you scroll, the story of the bean should unfold: origin, harvest, roast, cup. Something that stays put while the story changes over it would be great. Zero dependencies please, one HTML file plus whatever assets it needs.
evals.expected_output: A standalone page with a pinned/sticky section whose chapters cross-fade across scroll progress, content present in the HTML at load, a real reduced-motion layout that releases the pins, and no scroll hijacking.

assertions.text: Page loads with no uncaught JavaScript errors
Renders identically at the same scroll offset going down and coming back up (state is derived from progress, not accumulated)
Something actually sticks — no intermediate overflow ancestor silently disables the pin
All prose remains readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than frozen at opacity 0
Reduced-motion handling releases pinning and tall tracks instead of merely zeroing animation duration
Does not call preventDefault on wheel/touchmove (no scroll hijacking)
Full-screen stages use svh rather than bare 100vh
Does not write layout properties (top/left/width/height) per frame
The four narrative beats (origin, harvest, roast, cup) are all present as text in the HTML source at load
assertions.check: grep the four beat names in the served HTML
